feed.subtitle: Ph.D. student in the School of Design at Southern University of Science and Technology, researching HCI, XR, haptics, and perception.

entry.title: The Effect of Building Typology and Visual Complexity on Stress Levels through Amplitude Spectrum Analysis

link.title: The Effect of Building Typology and Visual Complexity on Stress Levels through Amplitude Spectrum Analysis

entry.summary: [Building Research & Information] An integrative framework combining immersive VR, amplitude spectrum analysis, and heart rate variability to examine how the visual structure of urban streetscapes relates to physiological stress.

entry.summary: [IJHCI] A study demonstrates that wall transparency is a critical design concept in VR collaboration, shaping attention, stress, and collaborative experience.
